prior_ambiguities: Who understood the covert leader substitution after the exam?
Why did Ibuki continue to deal with Ryūen? (self-reported only)

later_revelations.explanation: Ibuki claims she remained with Ryūen after failing to deduce the effective final D leader; she still did not know the private replacement outcome during the island test.

Manabu explicitly identifies Kiyotaka as the final substituted Class D island leader and suspects his strategic role; Kiyotaka deflects to Suzune. Manabu says only the examination committee and he held the information before this meeting; secretary Tachibana now hears it, while homeroom teachers reportedly do not.

unresolved: Ryūen–Katsuragi island cooperation's exact financial contract remains unknown; no facts about it added from 4.5
Which members of the examination committee know the substitution is unspecified; committee access must not imply knowledge for every teacher or classmate.
